ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the raw product was ingested into the system

reportFolder.description: Source folder or path where the report file was collected

reportName.description: Base file name of the ingested report (basename of the source file)

file_name.description: File name declared in the Earth Explorer header Fixed_Header/File_Name

mission.description: Mission identifier from the Earth Explorer header Fixed_Header/Mission

subsystem.description: Satellite subsystem affected by the unavailability (Subsystem element)

start_time.description: Start time of the unavailability period (StartTime element)

start_orbit.description: Orbit number at the start of the unavailability (StartOrbit element, normalized)

start_anx_offset.description: Offset from the ascending node crossing at the start of the unavailability (StartAnxOffset element)

end_time.description: End time of the unavailability period (EndTime element)

end_orbit.description: Orbit number at the end of the unavailability (EndOrbit element, normalized)

end_anx_offset.description: Offset from the ascending node crossing at the end of the unavailability (EndAnxOffset element)

type.description: Type of the unavailability entry (Type element)

comment.description: Free-text comment describing the unavailability (Comment element)

interface_name.description: Interface that provided the product, set to the constant Satellite-Unavailability

production_service_type.description: Production service type, set to the constant AUXIP

production_service_name.description: Production service name, set to the constant Exprivia

description.description: Free-text description of the unavailability record

file_version.description: Version of the source unavailability file

file_class.description: File class of the source Earth Explorer file

file_type.description: File type of the source Earth Explorer file

notes.description: Additional free-text notes attached to the unavailability record

source_creation_date.description: Creation date of the source file as declared by the producer

source_creator.description: Identifier of the entity that created the source file

source_system.description: System that produced the source file

validity_start.description: Start of the validity period declared in the source file

validity_stop.description: End of the validity period declared in the source file

end_doy.description: Day of year corresponding to the end of the unavailability

start_doy.description: Day of year corresponding to the start of the unavailability

unique_identifier.description: Unique identifier of the unavailability record
